issues.legal_issue: A civil court lacks jurisdiction over a suit concerning agricultural land where the plaintiff’s own case requires determination of joint rights in the land or the plaintiff is no longer recorded as its tenure holder after mutation in favour of the purchasers.
material_facts: The plaintiff sought cancellation of sale instruments affecting both agricultural and abadi land, alleging that other persons also had rights in the agricultural land and that he was not its sole owner.
The revenue records had removed the plaintiff’s name and entered the purchasers’ names.
The trial court held that the civil court had jurisdiction over the abadi land but not the agricultural land; that determination concerning the abadi land became final.
The High Court held that the civil court could hear the cancellation suit, but the Supreme Court concluded that the agricultural-land dispute belonged before the revenue court.
issues.conclusion: The appeal was allowed, the High Court’s order was set aside, and the lower courts’ orders were restored. The civil court had no jurisdiction over the agricultural-land claim; the ruling concerning abadi land remained undisturbed.
issues.legal_principle: Under Section 229B of the U.P. Zamindari Abolition and Land Reforms Act, a claim to bhumidhari rights, including jointly held rights, is for the revenue court. Under Shri Ram v. Ist Addl. Distt. Judge, a recorded tenure holder in possession whose title is not under cloud may sue in civil court to cancel a sale deed obtained by fraud or impersonation; by contrast, a person who is not a recorded tenure holder and must establish title must seek relief in the revenue court. The legality of changes to the revenue records at issue here was also for the revenue court to determine.

predicates.agricultural_land_civil_suit: The plaintiff brought a civil suit challenging sale instruments affecting agricultural land.
predicates.joint_rights_claim: The plaintiff alleged that other persons also held rights in the land and that the plaintiff was not its sole owner.
predicates.plaintiff_removed_from_records: The revenue records removed the plaintiff’s name and entered the purchasers’ names.

issues.definition: When a civil suit challenges instruments affecting agricultural land and the plaintiff either alleges joint rights in the land or has been removed from the revenue records in favour of the purchasers, the civil court lacks jurisdiction over the agricultural-land claim.
